messages:
Ravi Shah: quick flag 
We got a jump in 'High Renewal Risk' for mid-market this morning, looks correlated with last night's scorer run.
Olivia Park: saw that. cs-ops-bot spike at 03:02 UTC.
cs-ops-bot: [ALERT] healthscore:renewal-risk  48 accounts flagged in 10m (baseline 9). scorer build: v3.4.1.
Jordan Miles: pulled a sample. many rows have last_active = NULL but recent events exist. pipeline switched archived events to event_time last week, but the scorer still reads created_at.
Priya Menon: can we pause renewal outreach until we confirm? no one wants false alarms.
Ravi Shah: paused: /campaign pause renewal-nudge --reason "scorer input mismatch"
cs-ops-bot: [ACTION] campaign:renewal-nudge paused by Ravi Shah at 03:10 UTC.
Olivia Park: running a dry backfill now to infer last_active from events and will post results. if backfill shows many restores, we'll run idempotent update and add guard in scorer to prefer inferred when last_active is NULL.
Jordan Miles: dry-run results: 46 inferred updates for mid-market. saved CSV at /mnt/csops/backfills/4332156789-inferred.csv
Priya Menon: good. draft customer note ready for the handful who received emails; will wait until we confirm corrections.
Ravi Shah: plan: 1) apply backfill to prod idempotently, 2) deploy scorer patch with null-guard to prod canary, 3) resume campaign after metrics stable for 30m. I'll open PR for the guard.
cs-ops-bot: [NOTE] backfill dry-run artifact uploaded.
Olivia Park: deployed canary scorer v3.4.2-canary to 5% and reran. distribution returned to baseline.
Priya Menon: resuming campaign now. /campaign resume renewal-nudge --reason "input fix & canary ok"
cs-ops-bot: [ACTION] campaign:renewal-nudge resumed by Priya Menon at 03:46 UTC.
Ravi Shah: adding a short runbook entry: "healthscore-inferred-last-active" and ticket RED-CS-929 for event-pipeline test to prevent future regressions.
Priya Menon: thanks everyone, looping CS leads. :white_check_mark:
